encoding: utf-8 json, one object per datagram

fields.host_time_ns: sender wall clock in nanoseconds since epoch
fields.monotonic_s: sender monotonic seconds at capture time
fields.valid: boolean; false means pose not usable this frame
fields.position_m: [x, y, z] metres in frame, null when invalid
fields.orientation_wxyz: [w, x, y, z] world_from_body, null when unavailable
fields.reprojection_px: RMS reprojection error in pixels, null when unavailable
fields.inliers: number of accepted correspondences, null when unavailable
fields.ambiguity_ratio: planar PnP ambiguity metric, null when unavailable
fields.note: optional short human-readable reason, null when absent

driver_agent_todo: The driver agent must confirm it listens on this endpoint and agrees with the psvr_world axes (+X right, +Y up, -Z forward) before the position stream is enabled. Position from the camera is a separate metric source from IMU orientation; neither is assumed calibrated.
